description: This file defines the 'Entity' interface, a core abstraction representing top-level entities within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for accessing entity identifiers, revisions, timestamps, metadata, deletion status, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Entity
classes.description: An interface representing a top-level entity with methods to access its ID, revision, timestamps, metadata, deletion status, and JSON serialization functionalities.

parameters.T: The type of the entity's revision, extending Revision<T>.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Deprecated method returning the entity's ID as a String. Use getEntityId() with typed ID instead.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the entity's ID, typed as EntityId.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the current revision of the entity.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp when the entity was last modified.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp when the entity was created.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the metadata associated with the entity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the entity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Default method to serialize the entity into a JSON object including non-hidden marked fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Overloaded method to serialize the entity into a JSON object based on specified schema version and field selector.
